thread:
tara: Heads-up — sampling math in the playbook-runner is skewing onboarding queues. We're seeing Tier B accounts sampled at ~0.8% instead of the expected 8% for the last 24h. This is causing missed onboarding nudges and a backlog. cc @jordan @matt
jordan: :eyes: can you paste the query / config? does this affect all regions?
tara: only us-east for now. query below + the playbook snippet that runs the sampler.
```sql
SELECT account_id, bucket, COUNT(*) FROM onboarding_events
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY account_id, bucket;
```
```yaml
playbook:
  id: onboarding-sampler-v3
  sample_rate:
    default: 0.08
    override:
      tier_b: 0.008  # oops legacy value
  window: 24h
```
jordan: yep that's the bug — tier_b got a legacy override. how long has that config been live?
tara: config change landed 3 days ago in staging and accidentally deployed to prod via the rollout script. not flagged by the config-lint because it passed schema.
matt: we should add an integration test to catch improbable sampling deltas (eg >5x change). also can we run a one-off backfill to retro-apply nudges for missed accounts?
laura: I can run the backfill for us-east: backfill tool expects a list of account_ids. tara can you dump the affected account ids to S3 and share link?
tara: uploading now: s3://redwood-internal/temp/onboard-sampler-1739456789.csv
cs-ops-bot: ALERT: playbook-runner deployed onboarding-sampler-v3 to prod at 2026-03-22T14:12:07Z — rollout id r-9f4a
jordan: thanks. action plan:
1) revert override for tier_b (tara)
2) run backfill job (laura + cs-ops-bot) — ETA 2h
3) add sampling delta gate to CI (matt)
4) postmortem note to ops docs (tara)
matt: +1. I'll open a PR for the delta gate and add a unit that calculates effective sample_rate across a 24h window.
tara: reverted the override. prod sampler now at expected rates. patch PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/pull/412
laura: kicked off backfill with task-id backfill-1739456810, monitoring in ops-runner. will update when done.
cs-ops-bot: BACKFILL finished: backfill-1739456810 — succeeded — 3,812 accounts nudged.
jordan: nice. tara can you draft 1-paragraph root cause and the brief remediation steps? we'll add to weekly ops retro.
tara: will do and add the config-lint rule. thanks team :thumbsup:
laura: quick note — add a telemetry metric for 'effective_sampling_rate' per tier so we can alert next time.
matt: adding metric to observability board. tagging this resolved unless any other blockers.
jordan: resolved from my side. closing thread.
